about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Be present with us, O Lord our God, that by these things which we have faithfully received we may be cleansed from our faults and delivered from all dangers. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
g: be near, be present, be in attendance, arrive, appear
